# wwtracker — WaveWarZ On-Chain Analytics Dashboard

wwtracker is an unofficial, open-source analytics dashboard for WaveWarZ, a Solana-based music-battle prediction market. It surfaces on-chain data, battle history, trader PnL, and ecosystem context. Live at https://wwtracker.vercel.app.

## What it tracks

WaveWarZ is a Solana program (`9TUfEHvk5fN5vogtQyrefgNqzKy2Bqb4nWVhSFUg2fYo`) where:
- Artists compete song-vs-song in timed battles
- Fans trade SOL on-chain on who wins (bonding curve, buyShares / sellShares)
- Winners are decided by a 2-of-3 system: community poll + SOL trading volume (charts) + DJ Wavy (AI judge)
- Artist payouts and trader claims settle automatically on-chain via `endBattle` + `claimShares`

## Verified platform stats (2026-07-16, source: wavewarz.info/api/public/stats)

- Total battles: 1,244 (1,046 quick + 162 main-event + 36 community + 50 main events)
- Total SOL volume: 522+ SOL (~$39K USD at $75/SOL)
- Artist payouts: 9.05 SOL (automatic, onchain)
- Trader claims: 127.34 SOL (manual, claimShares)
- Platform revenue: 17.42 SOL
- 122 unique traders (distinct buyShares signers, Dune snapshot 2026-06-14)
- Treasury operating floor: 3.5 SOL (tracked via Dune query 7717935)

## Key addresses

- Program: `9TUfEHvk5fN5vogtQyrefgNqzKy2Bqb4nWVhSFUg2fYo`
- Treasury / dev wallet: `FNjYtwKVsbQzSmoBgLqa8ZGSJTzexQJi6xmV97iakq37`

## What this app shows

- **Treasury floor**: daily SOL balance vs 3.5 SOL operating floor (live, Dune)
- **Platform analytics**: instruction-decoded battle/trade/claim counts and timelines (Dune snapshot)
- **Battle history**: all 1,200+ battles with search, filter, CSV export (wavewarz.info feed)
- **Trader PnL**: per-wallet realized SOL P&L lookup (flow-based from Dune)
- **Music**: Audius-backed song leaderboard and artist roster
- **Ecosystem**: ZAO context, events, FAQ

## The ZAO — parent ecosystem

WaveWarZ is a production lane inside **The ZAO** (ZTalent Artist Organization), a decentralized impact network returning profit margin, data, and IP rights to artists. Founded by Zaal Panthaki ([@bettercallzaal](https://x.com/bettercallzaal)).

- The ZAO has run 100+ consecutive Respect Game (Fractal) weeks without missing a cycle (since 2024-07-30)
- Governance: onchain Respect tokens (Optimism) + ZAO Improvement Proposals (ZIPs)
- WaveWarZ stack: BCZ → The ZAO → WaveWarZ
- ZAO website: https://thezao.com
- ZAO ZAOOS repo (public): https://github.com/bettercallzaal/ZAOOS

## Live data APIs

- WaveWarZ stats: `GET https://wavewarz.info/api/public/stats` (no auth, CORS open, 60s cache)
  Returns: volume, liveBattle, artistPayouts, traderClaims, platformRevenue, battles breakdown
- Treasury balance: `GET https://wwtracker.vercel.app/api/balance` (cached Dune read, no auth)
